PullRequest.Title: dictation: reuse cached Nemotron model after restart
PullRequest.Body:
Fixes #336592

Foundry Local 1.x can retain stale selected-variant metadata after startup. For Nemotron, that can leave the alias pointing at an uncached variant even though a compatible variant is already persisted on disk, causing VS Code to download the model again.

This change checks the SDK's live cache state across the model variants and selects an existing cached variant before deciding to download. It also adds regression coverage for stale and already-cached selections.

Validation:
- `npm run transpile-client`
- `./scripts/test.sh --run src/vs/platform/localTranscription/test/node/localTranscriptionService.test.ts`
- `npm run eslint -- src/vs/platform/localTranscription/node/localTranscriptionService.ts src/vs/platform/localTranscription/test/node/localTranscriptionService.test.ts`
- `git diff --check`

The full client type-check was attempted but this checkout lacks the Electron and `original-fs` type dependencies; none of the reported errors referenced the changed files.

RegressionFixes.Mechanism: Across utility-process restarts, stale catalog selection metadata could identify an uncached variant despite a compatible variant already existing in the disk cache, causing the model preparation path to fetch the model again before transcription could start.
RegressionFixes.Symptom: An already-installed, hundreds-of-megabytes dictation model could be downloaded again after restart, consuming network bandwidth and delaying first local transcription.
RegressionFixes.FixedBehavior: After catalog lookup, the service checks the selected variant first, then scans the model's bounded variant metadata and selects an already-cached variant. The subsequent existing `model.isCached` branch therefore skips the unnecessary network download and proceeds to load the persisted model.
RegressionFixes.Evidence: Before this change, `_ensureModel` trusted only the catalog-selected model's `isCached` value at base line 556 and immediately entered `model.download()` when it was false. The added helper and regression test establish that the selected variant can be uncached while another variant in the same catalog model is already persisted. The local dictation caller states first-use model downloads can be hundreds of MB and transcription cannot begin until model preparation reaches load/session startup. The helper is invoked immediately after the single coalesced `catalog.getModel(modelId)` result and before the download branch.

Scenarios.Scenario: First on-device dictation after a utility-process restart when catalog selection is stale but a compatible model variant is already cached on disk
Scenarios.CriticalPath: The renderer sends one `start` IPC and begins buffering audio; first transcription output depends on `_openSession` completing runtime provisioning, SDK/manager initialization, one catalog lookup, cached-variant selection, model load, and native session start. The added scan is on this first-transcript critical path, but it replaces a conditional hundreds-of-MB model download in the affected state.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One IPC call per local dictation start
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same IPC call started every local dictation session.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: The call starts preparation but returns before model loading; transcript production waits for the utility-process preparation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Provision/check the Foundry Local native runtime cache
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One provisioning check per cold model preparation; network fetch only when the runtime cache is cold
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: Identical runtime cache check and optional download.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before SDK import and model preparation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Native SDK catalog lookup for the configured model
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One lookup per model preparation after process start, coalesced for the same model ID
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same single catalog lookup was performed.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before cache selection, model load, and session creation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: Previously one download when stale selected-variant metadata reported uncached; now zero when any returned variant reports cached
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The stale-selection scenario entered `model.download()` despite an existing compatible disk-cached variant.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Audio is buffered and first transcript is delayed until this download and subsequent load complete.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Load model files through the native SDK
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One model load after variant selection
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: One load occurred after the unnecessary download.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Required before opening the transcription session.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of variants attached to one catalog model after SDK filtering; same-model starts are coalesced, so this does not scale with audio chunks or UI events.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The service supports one active transcription session, and `_modelPromise` coalesces concurrent preparation requests for the same model ID. Variant checks are synchronous and serial over the one returned model's variants; no new parallel boundary burst is introduced.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The process-local `_model`/`_modelPromise` cache avoids repeated catalog work after a successful load. On a fresh process, the SDK disk cache is authoritative per variant; the diff now checks that positive cache state before deciding to download. Failures clear `_modelPromise`, so retries remain unchanged.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High: changed-line placement, the model-status branch, the new stale-selection test, and the caller's preparation path directly establish that the scan precedes and can eliminate the download boundary.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: The repository does not expose the SDK's exact variant count or the implementation cost of `isCached`, but the scan occurs once over one model's finite catalog variants, while the avoided model download is documented in the caller as potentially hundreds of MB.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression. The bounded metadata scan adds negligible once-per-cold-preparation CPU work and removes an unnecessary network download in the target state.

Scenarios.Scenario: First on-device dictation with a genuine cold model cache
Scenarios.CriticalPath: After one start IPC, transcript production waits for runtime setup, SDK manager creation, catalog lookup, the new variant scan, one model download, model load, and session start. The scan is on the critical path but does not add a new established filesystem or network operation.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Download model files after all variants report uncached
ExpensiveBoundaries.Cardinality: One SDK download for the selected model variant
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same single download occurred on a genuine cache miss.
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Blocks model load and first transcript, though capture continues into an in-memory audio buffer.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Load downloaded model into the native runtime
ExpensiveBoundaries.PreviousBehavior: The same one load followed download.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Finite variant count V for one configured model, not number of recordings or audio chunks within the process lifetime.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: One active session; preparation for the same model ID is coalesced by `_modelPromise`. The variant scan is serial, while the model download remains a single SDK operation.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: All variants miss the disk cache, so the helper scans once and preserves the existing selected variant. Successful load populates the process-local model cache; failure clearing/retry behavior is unchanged.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High that the only added work is O(V) property reads and that download cardinality remains one; there is no code evidence of a newly introduced expensive boundary.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: Exact variant count and synchronous getter implementation are external to the repository, but catalog variants are attached to one selected model and the code performs only a first-match linear scan once per cold preparation.
Scenarios.Verdict: No reportable regression: cold-cache behavior retains one download and adds only bounded model-variant inspection.

Scenarios.Scenario: Subsequent on-device dictation using the same model in the same utility-process lifetime
Scenarios.CriticalPath: `_ensureModel` returns the already-loaded `_model` before catalog lookup and before the new helper; session creation/start is the remaining native critical path.

ExpensiveBoundaries.Operation: Start a native live transcription session
ExpensiveBoundaries.CriticalPathEffect: Must complete before buffered audio is flushed and results can arrive.

Scenarios.ScalingInput: Number of recordings in one utility-process lifetime; added work remains zero after the first successful model load.
Scenarios.EffectiveConcurrency: The service remains single-session, and no variant scan, catalog call, or model download occurs on this path.
Scenarios.CacheBehavior: The `_model` positive cache short-circuits at the top of `_ensureModel`, so the changed helper is not reached on warm same-model recordings. No negative cache behavior changed.
Scenarios.MechanismConfidence: High from the explicit `_model` and model-ID guard before the changed region.
Scenarios.MagnitudeUncertainty: None material to the diff; the added code executes zero times on this path.
Scenarios.Verdict: No performance change on the warm recording path.

Analysis.Summary: Completed the performance pass over both changed files and all diff pages. The runtime change performs a bounded once-per-cold-model variant scan, is bypassed by the existing warm model cache, preserves coalescing, and reduces network I/O when stale selected-variant metadata would otherwise trigger a redundant model download. No diff-introduced performance finding was identified; the repaired cache-lifecycle regression was recorded separately.

Stats.CostNote: Copilot SDK reports nano-AI units and model billing multipliers; it does not provide a USD conversion.
